**Finding submitted: deviation (fallback-level cure).**

- **What exists:** § 11.4 (p0192) gives Termination Assistance on expiry *or any termination for any reason*, at M&I's then-current rates, plus a transition plan and no obligation to take assistance from M&I. Those two elements (expiry/termination trigger; then-current rates) are satisfied.
- **Why it fails fallback:** the only quantified period — six months of continued Services — is gated on a written request **at least 100 days before expiration of the Term**, so it is unavailable after any mid-term termination; a pre-expiry request condition does not establish a post-termination duration. And no provision anywhere requires return or export of Customer Data — § 17.1 only confirms ownership, § 17.5 only requires safeguards.
- **Cure:** one inserted § 11.5 carrying only the two missing fallback elements — at least 90 days of Termination Assistance following any expiry or termination, and export/delivery of all Customer Data within 30 days. The existing six-month expiry mechanic, rates basis, and expense allocation are left verbatim; preferred-only extras (machine-readable format, certified deletion) were not volunteered at the fallback threshold.
